finding: WAVE2B (2026-10-01) re-run: printed 'Exile target nonland permanent. ITS CONTROLLER creates a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.' The exile lands in the OWNER's exile zone correctly, but the Soldier token enters under the SPELL'S CASTER: the compiled CREATE_TOKEN atom carries only the tokens role (no controller role at all), and verbs.py:655 _v_create_token mints the handle at ctx.controller unconditionally — there is no role lane for the anaphoric 'its controller'. The harness tokens lane counts tokens by NAME without a controller dimension, so the expressible half above passes while the printed controller promise is broken for every opponent-controlled target.
